scope: Issue #81 open leads (Part 1), deeper IE/GB/FR/EU records (Part 2), company US operations (Part 3). Only probe-HIT verbatims count; verified:true only where every factual field's phrase HITs.
budget_note: About 40 fetches (WebFetch + probe.py). Several primaries are blocked (Legifrance 403, economie.gouv.fr PPE 403, IMDA page JS-only, OpenAI page 403, Microsoft/AWS/Blackstone planning portals not reached). Part 2 is short of the 4-8 per country target; see notes.

part1_results.detail: EDB/IMDA joint release of 20 July 2022 (EDB PDF) states the government informed industry of a temporary pause in 2019 and launched the pilot DC-CFA. Authority statement satisfies the de_facto corroboration rule. Exact lifted date is inferred from the launch date; the release does not use the word 'lifted'.

part1_results.topic: Ireland CRU LEU connection decision CRU/2025236
part1_results.detail: Final decision paper read from cru.ie (publication page 28906, 12 Dec 2025) and the decision PDF (PDFKit/probe). 80% renewable matching, 1 MVA de-minimis, dispatchable onsite/proximate generation for MIC >= 10 MVA all HIT. Also confirms the decision supersedes Direction CRU/21/124 (the 2021 'effective freeze' lead, #5 in issue #81): no new Moratorium record, lineage only.

part1_results.topic: France heat-recovery obligation (decree 2025-1382, Code de l'energie L.236-2)
part1_results.detail: Legifrance (JORFTEXT000053201866 and L236-2) returns 403 to probe and WebFetch. Search snippets give the decree number and 29 Dec 2025 date, and a 1 MW threshold, but a snippet is not a fetched page. The 20% reuse factor appears only in secondary sources and is contradicted by the search summary. Not shipped. Needs a manual Legifrance read or a CNIL-style mirror. Also not found: a verified ecologie.gouv.fr page (the PPE 2026-2035 PDF returned 403).

AEMC media release (12 March 2026) on the draft rule ERC0394 'Improving the NEM access standards - Package 2' is verified: raises the large inverter-based load threshold from 5 MW to 30 MW. This is a technical access standard, not a cost-allocation rule. The 'own connection costs' national proposal (aiunderstanding.org) is not verified; no DCCEEW or National Cabinet primary found. Stage per secondary: final determination expected late October 2026, not confirmed on AEMC.

Sur Energy press release (sur.energy/press-release) is probe-verified: LOI for up to 500MW, first Stargate in Latin America, up to $25 billion, structured within RIGI. It does not name a province or site, and 'Patagonia' and 'Neuquen' do not appear on it. The Patagonia reporting is press-only. The Neuquen 500 MW project is Pampa Energia, not Stargate, and must not be conflated. OpenAI's own page is 403 to probe.

fields.duration_description: Temporary pause in the growth of data centres, announced in 2019; new capacity reopened through the pilot Data Centre Call for Application launched 20 July 2022
fields.summary: The government informed industry of a temporary pause in data-centre growth in 2019 and started a review. After consultation, EDB and IMDA launched a pilot call for applications in July 2022 for new capacity with sustainability conditions.

records.source_title: EDB and IMDA joint release — Launch of pilot Data Centre Call for Application (20 July 2022)
records.verbatim: The Government informed the industry of a temporary pause in the growth of DCs in 2019 and embarked on a review.
verbatims: The Government informed the industry of a temporary pause in the growth of DCs in 2019 and embarked on a review.
EDB and IMDA have launched a pilot Data Centre (DC)-Call for Application Exercise (DC-CFA)
records.notes: Authority's own statement (EDB + IMDA), so de_facto corroboration is met without a second source. The release gives no exact 2019 date, so enacted_date is null. lifted_date 2022-07-20 is the pilot launch date; the release does not say 'lifted'. Trade press (Reed Smith, DCD) calls it a moratorium that 'was lifted' but is not cited as the basis. Resources to add: the 2022 release itself (already source_url).

records.notes: Confirms the 2022 pilot parameters from the authority's Annex A. Closing date (21 November 2022) is in the same annex but its phrase did not probe cleanly; not added. The green-energy condition from DC-CFA2 is not in this pilot record.

key_terms: Data centres with MIC equal to or above the de-minimis level are required to meet at least 80% of their annual demand with additional renewable electricity generated in the Republic of Ireland.
this de-minimis level will be set at 1 MVA

Data centres with MIC equal to or greater than 10MVA ... are required to provide dispatchable onsite or proximate generation and/or storage capacity which matches their MIC (subject to derating requirements)
fields.summary_addition: Decision paper CRU/2025236 (12 Dec 2025). Below 1 MVA MIC: de-minimis, no dispatchable or renewable requirement. 1 MVA to 10 MVA: separate requirements. 10 MVA and above: onsite or proximate dispatchable generation matching MIC, plus 80% annual renewable matching. It supersedes Direction CRU/21/124 (the 2021 direction, so no separate Moratorium record). Judicial review proceedings against the CRU decision were reported by EirGrid in May 2026.

records.source_title: CRU — Large Energy Users connection policy decision paper (CRU2025236, 12 December 2025)
records.verbatim: Data centres with MIC equal to or above the de-minimis level are required to meet at least 80% of their annual demand with additional renewable electricity generated in the Republic of Ireland.
verbatims: Data centres with MIC equal to or above the de-minimis level are required to meet at least 80% of their annual demand with additional renewable electricity generated in the Republic of Ireland.
this de-minimis level will be set at 1 MVA
The CRU is of the view that data centre connection applications seeking a Maximum Import Capacity (MIC) of 10MVA and above should be required to provide onsite or proximate generation and/or storage
This direction supersedes Direction CRU/21/124 and will apply to all new connection applications for new or additional capacity captured under the scope of the decision.

resources.title: CRU publication page: Review of Large Energy Users Connection Policy (12 Dec 2025)

records.notes: Final decision PDF probe-HIT. The 'dispatchable ... matches their MIC' sentence was read in the probe output of the same PDF (exact-phrase probe not re-run). The 'Mandatory Demand Curtailment' exemption for dispatchable-generation connections is also in the decision (not added). Proposed decision CRU202504 (18 Feb 2025, consultation to 4 April 2025) is in resources. Law-firm summaries are not used.
